item.tib: gnam sa skyi 'dangs mdel thung la thog ser sbag ma
item.coloph: dbal mo las kyi thig le/ ma bu sde skor 'di rnams zab la 'bras bu myur bas/ hris pa gyer med dang / khod spungs dran pa gnyis kyis/ gces par dgongs nas/ cha gcig gsang brag rgya bo la sbas/ cha gcig lcags 'phrang mdo phugs la sbas/ cha gcig yar lha sham po la sbas/ 'di rnams sbas dus su me chu rlung gis mi 'khyer ba'i smon lam dang bkra shis gsol/ sman dang 'gi wang gur gum gyis byug pa byas/ phyi dus dar cing 'phel rgyas smon lam btab pa'o/ phyi rabs las can gcig gis 'phel rgyas spyod 'gyur ro/ dam med bon gyi tshongs (tshong) pa la ag thams (tham/)yum sras lnga'i thub par bsrungs(srungs//)
